translation.name: Kitapm kɛn Raa dɔɔko kiji ute jeege

book.name: 1 Kɔrint
book.title: Maktubm deet deetn kɛn Pɔl raaŋin̰ eglizn Kɔrint ki

content: Pɔl taaɗ Taar *Raa jeege tun Kɔrint ki

Gɛnaamge, kɛn maam jaay mꞋiŋgo gɔtse ki taa mꞋasen taaɗn *nakŋ kɛn Raa ɔyin̰ga kɔy taaɗ te mɛtin̰ jeege tu ey se, maakŋ taarumge tu se, maam mꞋtaaɗsen te taargen ɔɔn̰ɔ ɔɔn̰ eyo ɔɔ ute jeel taargen deel do eyo.
Num maakse ki se, maam mꞋuunoga doa mꞋje jeel ɗim kuuy eyo, nakŋ kɛn maam mꞋje jeel se, Isa *al‑Masi ɔɔ Isa al‑Masi se ɓo kꞋtup kꞋtɔɔlin̰ ro kaag ki se.
Kɛn maam mꞋiŋgo gɔtse ki se, maam mꞋnaam mꞋɔk rom se tɔɔgum baata, maam mꞋɓeere ɔkuma ɔɔ rom ook marga jɛg jɛg.

Taar kɛn maam mꞋtaaɗseni ute dooy kɛn maam mꞋdooyseno se, mꞋtaaɗsesin̰o se ute jeel‑taara kɛn jikilimge lee taaɗin̰ nijim se eyo, num gaŋ maakŋ taar kɛn maam mꞋtaaɗsen se, kɛse *Nirl Raa ɓo taaɗ tɔɔgin̰a.
Bin ɓo, kaal maakŋ naase aalki se, Ꞌtɛɗn do jeel‑taar jikilimge tu eyo, num do tɔɔgŋ Raa ki.
Jeel‑taar kɛn *Nirl Raa ɛɗ jeege tu

Anum kɛse ɓo jeel‑taar kɛn naaje kꞋdooy jee al‑Masigen kɛn jeel ɔkga kɔk ɗoobm Mɛljege. Jeel‑taar ese se gɛn do *duni ara ute jeegen ɔk tɔɔgŋ iŋg do jeege tun do duni ki ara ki eyo, naaɗe se ɓo kɛn utu Ꞌkut se.

Naaje kꞋdooy jeege ute jeel‑taar Raa ese se kɛn jikilimge jeel mɛtin̰ eyo taa taar se Raa ɔyɗesin̰oga kɔyo. Ey num Raa se kaaɗ kɛn naan̰ aalo te do naaŋ ey ɓɔrt se ɓo, naan̰ uunoga kuun doa taa ajeki kɛɗn jeel‑taarin̰a gɛn kɛnd maakŋ *nookin̰ ki.

Ɔɔ jeel‑taar se maakŋ magalge tun iŋg do jeege tu se nam kalaŋ tap ɓo booy ɔk te mɛtin̰ eyo. Ey num kɛn naaɗe jaay booy ɔkoga kɔk mɛtin̰ num, Mɛljegen kꞋnookin̰ se, naaɗe an̰ kɔŋ tupm tɔɔl ro kaag ki eyo.
Num gaŋ aan gɔɔ kɛn Kitap taaɗa:

content.text: Nakŋ se nam ɓii kalaŋ aakin̰ te ute kaamin̰ eyo
ɔɔ booyin̰ te ute bin̰ eyo
ɔɔ nam saap aan te do ki ey kici,
nakgen se Raa tɔnd ɗaapin̰oga ɗaap jeege tun jen̰a.

content: Ɗeere, nakgen se te ɗoobm Nirl Raa se, Raa taaɗjekiga mɛtin̰ tooɗga tal. Taa *Nirl Salal se jeel naŋ nakge paac bini nakŋ maakŋ maak‑saap Raa ki kici.
Saapm debkilimi se tap ɓo, naŋa jeele? Gɔtɔ! Kɛn jeel saapm debkilimi se, naan̰ malin̰ sum. Ɔɔ Raa kic ɓo nam jeel saapin̰ eyo; kɛn jeel saapin̰ se, Nirl naan̰ malin̰ sum.
Anum Nirl naajege kꞋjꞋɔkki se gɛn do duni ara ki eyo, num Nirl kɛn naajege kꞋjꞋɔkki se iin̰o gɔtn Raa ki. Ute naan̰ se ɓo naajege kꞋjeelki bɛɛ kɛn Raa tɛɗjeki ute maraadin̰ se.

Taargen naaje kꞋtaaɗ jeege tu se, ute jeel‑taar kɛn jikilimge lee dooy jeege se eyo, naɓo naaje se kꞋdooy jeege ute jeel‑taar kɛn Nirl Raa ɛɗjeni. Naaje kꞋtaaɗ mɛtn nakgen iin̰o gɔtn Nirl Raa ki jeege tun kɛn ɔk Nirl ese se.

Goon debkilim ɔnd don̰ do saapm naan̰ malin̰ ki sum se, Ꞌkɔŋ tookŋ do nak kɛn iin̰o gɔtn Nirl Raa ki eyo. Naan̰ aakin̰ aan gɔɔ nakŋ jee dɛrlge ɔɔ naan̰ lɛ, ɔŋ aasin̰ gɛn booy kɔkŋ mɛtin̰ eyo, taa nakgen bin se, Nirl Raa kalin̰ ki sum ɓo Ꞌtaaɗn tɔɔkŋ mɛtin̰ jeege tu.
Num gaŋ debm ɔk Nirl Raa se, naan̰ aak ɔk mɛtn nakge paac. Ɔɔ naan̰ malin̰ lɛ, nam kuuy an̰ kɔŋ kɔjn̰ bɔɔrɔ don̰ ki eyo.

content.text: Saapm Mɛljege se tap ɓo naŋa jeele ɔɔ naŋa tap ɓo dɛjin̰oga?

content: Anum naajege se jꞋɔkki saapm gɛn *al‑Masi se maakjege tu.
